summary: A single-story, L-shaped facility featuring distinct horizontal banding of brick, wood, and white blocks. It has a flat roof made of a dark material, topped with a central antenna or dish structure, and is surrounded by a low, spaced-out perimeter fence.
rebuild_hints: Lay out an L-shaped foundation using stone bricks.
Build the walls using alternating horizontal layers of wood planks and bricks, separated by white block bands.
Place vertical white block pillars protruding from the exterior walls at regular intervals.
Fill the flat roof with a dark block (resembling netherrack) and border it with white blocks.
Add glowstone blocks on top of the roof's white border for illumination.
Construct the central antenna using a brick pillar base, stone slabs, and a dark block top.
Create a perimeter fence using single white blocks spaced one block apart, following the L-shape of the building.
uncertainties: The exact type of white block used (quartz, iron, snow, or concrete) is unclear.
The dark material used for the roof surface is uncertain, though it strongly resembles netherrack.
The interior is completely obscured, so the internal layout and exact floor count are estimated.
